The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce9fe5976f17b89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 53-54. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix 0 < α ≤ 1, A > 0, the layer count, and the polynomial size exponent a > 0. There exist fixed constants θ = θ(α, A) > 0, p0 < ∞, and sufficiently small ε0 > 0 such that, after the compact cutoffs are chosen, the following bound holds uniformly for 0 < ε < ε0, p0 ≤ p ≤ Pa , h0 ≤ θp. For histories with at least αp affected lives, their absolute integral, divided by the source factor Ap of (6.9), is bounded by the sum of the exceptional-parameter contributions bounded by e−Ap and a contribution bounded by PCLp εcLp . (6.14) 53 The constants cL > 0 and CL are fixed before ε ↓ 0. The assertion includes recollisions, interference with a long-lived cluster, and contacts with detached or subtracted trajectories.
